title: Migrate ZUGFeRD, PEPPOL BIS 3.0 DE, Factur-X FR and Peppol BIS 3.0 FR to the V2 draft import pipeline
summary: German ZUGFeRD and PEPPOL BIS 3.0 DE formats and French Factur-X and PEPPOL BIS 3.0 FR formats are now migrated to the V2 draft import pipeline, enabling the draft-based workflow and Copilot-assisted matching previously unavailable for these localized e-document formats.
key_points: ZUGFeRD and Factur-X handlers implement both CII XML parsing and PDF/A-3 container extraction
PEPPOL BIS 3.0 handlers for both countries reuse existing UBL readers adapted for their regional specifications
French SIRET identifiers and German Leitweg-ID values are preserved during round-trip import-export cycles
New enum extension values added for Read into Draft and Structure Received workflows
German table extension field stores buyer reference data on E-Document Purchase Header
